title: Mechanistic Steering of LLMs Reveals Layer-wise Feature Vulnerabilities in Adversarial Settings
reasoning: The paper focuses on mechanistic interpretability and adversarial robustness of LLMs. While it uses harm categories from the BeaverTails dataset, such as 'non_violent_unethical_behavior' and 'discrimination,' it evaluates these as safety vulnerabilities and jailbreak success metrics rather than conducting a study or benchmark of religious beliefs, formal ethical frameworks, or moral reasoning.
